cd /workspace && python3 - << 'PY'
import json, subprocess, sys, os
ROOT='/workspace'
K = [REDACTED:SECRET]
hops = [11,12,13,14,15,16,17,18]
def child_rec(v, hop):
    # TYPE4 at depth 70, prefix rel=6, fragment = v << 58
    val = 4 | (hop << 3) | ((v << 58) << 25) | (6 << 89) | (hop << 97)
    return val & ((1<<128)-1)
def child32(key, stage, cell):
    return key | (stage << 6) | (cell << 10)
ABSENT = 15 << 6
# root TYPE3 at stage 10 cell 0
bulk_bitmap = 0
for k in range(3, 8): bulk_bitmap |= 1 << k
root = 3 | (4194303 << 3) | (0 << 25) | (0 << 41) | (bulk_bitmap << 63) | (0 << 127) | (5 << 149)
root |= child32(0, 9, 0) << 153
root |= child32(1, 9, 1) << 185
root |= child32(2, 9, 2) << 217
assert root < (1 << 256)
def word(v): return '%064x' % v
img = {"root": [10, 0], "front16": [], "front64": [[f"{K:016x}", 10, 0]],
       "cells": [0]*11, "banks": [[] for _ in range(11)], "bitmaps": ["0"*16], "nexthops": []}
img['cells'][10] = 2; img['banks'][10] = [word(root)]
# three direct children at stage 9, cells 0..2 (half records)
c = [child_rec(k, hops[k]) for k in range(3)]
img['cells'][9] = 3
img['banks'][9] = [word(c[0] | (c[1] << 128)), word(c[2])]
# five bulk children at stage 5, cells 0,2,4,6,8
img['cells'][5] = 10
img['banks'][5] = [word(child_rec(k, hops[k])) for k in range(3, 8)]
qs = []
for v in range(9):
    qs.append('%032x' % ((K << 64) | (v << 58)))
qs.append('%032x' % ((K << 64) | 0xdeadbeef))
ops = [["load", img], ["image_query", qs]]
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, os.path.join(ROOT,'run.py')], input=json.dumps({"cases":[{"ops":ops}]}).encode(), capture_output=True, cwd=ROOT, env=dict(os.environ, SCAMP_BINARY='/workspace/tmp/scamptrie', SCAMP_DEBUG='1'))
resp = json.loads(r.stdout.decode())
print('loads', resp['results'][0]['loads'])
print('answers', resp['results'][0]['answers'])
print('want', hops + [None, None])
